purpose: Attempt to reproduce the Android v1.5.5 post-login OEM runtime exception on the API 35 emulator
limitations: The AOSP emulator does not contain the OEM security component which generated the reported hardening-compatibility dialog.
The clean emulator Chrome profile had no authenticated IHEP session, and no credentials or tokens were injected.
The v1.5.5 MVP APK is not debuggable, so run-as cannot be used to seed a test authentication state.
A real post-login conclusion requires the user to complete OIDC interactively or a separately signed mock-OIDC acceptance build.
